responsibility: Public header for the Objective-C encoding subsystem. It declares initialization and entry points for producing method, field, @encode, and property-attribute encodings, defines the inline-versus-non-inline aggregate encoding mode constants, and exposes the shared generating_instance_variables state that tells encoding routines whether they are emitting ivar descriptors or method-signature style encodings.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the encoding subsystem: it declares entry points like encode_method_prototype, objc_build_encode_expr, encode_field_decl, and objc_v2_encode_prop_attr, plus the inline-definition mode constants and shared state variable. Unlike objc-encoding.cc, it does not generate encodings itself.
